owns: coding-agent job intake and durable history
agent worker claims, heartbeats, retries, and cancellation
does_not_own: Kubernetes cluster registration or GitOps tenancy

github.purpose: repository metadata, webhook intake, branches, commits, pull requests, and checks
github.required_scope: one assigned organization and the minimum assigned repositories
forbidden: credential in a task payload or model prompt

linear.purpose: canonical issue context and status evidence
required_behavior: resolve the canonical issue before creating duplicates
record issue identifier in branch, commit, and pull request
never place the credential in a worker payload

forbidden: mutable branch or tag as execution authority
unreviewed marketplace action execution in the independent lane
caller-selected Kubernetes manifest or runner image

fiducia.purpose: cross-process fencing for irreversible side effects and horizontally scaled claims
required_for: multiple coordinator replicas performing the same external mutation
webhook delivery claims shared across replicas
lease-protected merge, deploy, release, or credential rotation
not_required_for: single-transaction PostgreSQL queue claims with no external side effect

k8s-cluster.purpose: deployment registration, namespace tenancy, secrets delivery, shared NATS, and observability backends
forbidden: deployment from a mutable source reference

model_providers.purpose: provider-neutral inference after local policy and secret scanning
required_behavior: enforce organization, repository, and request budgets
record route and cost evidence without hidden chain-of-thought

side_effect_gates: the actor and tenant match the capability grant
the repository and operation are allowlisted
the capability and approval have not expired
the idempotency key has not already produced a terminal receipt
a current fencing token is present when horizontal execution can race
the exact side effect is recorded with evidence after completion

failure_semantics.provider_unavailable: use an allowed fallback or return a retryable terminal outcome
failure_semantics.worker_lease_expired: requeue only after the prior worker can no longer authorize a side effect
failure_semantics.ambiguous_external_result: do not retry blindly; reconcile provider or GitHub state first
failure_semantics.cancellation: stop new dispatch, revoke pending approvals, and reconcile in-flight work

forbidden_fields: raw model prompt containing repository secrets
raw model output containing repository secrets

deployment.artifact_policy: build once, test and sign the exact image, deploy by immutable digest
minimum_isolation: separate worker identity from coordinator identity
deployment.horizontal_scaling_gate: shared durable delivery claims or Fiducia-fenced claims must replace in-memory deduplication before multiple replicas perform external mutations
